title: Ofcom archive transport and schema acceptance
official_findings: Official Spring 2026 HTML exposes the fixed broadband ZIP as 32.2 MB.
A direct follow of the official ZIP link failed in the current web transport with (400) OK and returned no archive bytes.
Without bytes, SHA256, CRC, member names, headers, file counts and row counts are not asserted.
The January 2026 current snapshot semantics remain valid at HTML level.
Transport failure is never converted to NO_DATA or service absence.
